summary: A consequential operation commits in a durable write transaction: the store pins its connection, sets synchronous=FULL before BEGIN, verifies level 2, and restores NORMAL or discards the connection after commit or rollback. No post-commit checkpoint is needed. Consequential families include predecessor import and public fence entry points; the conformance harness still measures ordinary commits. A WAL size backstop remains an open measured follow-up.
title: A durable commit replaces the checkpoint barrier
